Do NOT enter interest on the business's OWN notes and accounts receivable — a receivable from the business's own sales, or a note taken in payment for them, is ordinary-course business income, not the return on capital the business is HOLDING, and section 469(e)(1)(B) reaches only income "attributable to an investment of working capital". What belongs here is interest or dividends on the business's cash reserves, bank deposits, certificates of deposit and short-term investments. Do NOT enter interest or dividends already reported on Form 1040 line 2b or line 3b — those are already on Form 8960 lines 1 and 2, and entering them again counts them twice. The Form 8960 instructions do not print a box or a line for this amount; it is asked because the statute puts the amount in net investment income and no other line on the form carries it.
Asked when: the return reports a Schedule C or a Schedule F. It is NOT asked, and is structurally moot, for a filer who has answered YES to the section 475(e)(2) trader attestation — that business's whole profit is already on Form 8960 line 4a with any interest inside it.
Unanswered posture: DEFAULTED to $0 through /niitLine7WorkingCapitalIncomeReportedInBusinessIncome, disclosed. It is an INCLUSION with no condition of allowance — leaving it blank is taxpayer-favourable and understates the tax — so the screen should be shown rather than skipped; it is not a claimed benefit that an unanswered question should refuse. Validation: Dollar, Min $0, ONE return-level amount rather than one per business, because Form 8960 line 7 is a single return-level box. What the answer feeds: Form 8960 line 7 -> line 8 -> line 12.

Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 9b, state, local and foreign income tax allocable to net investment income (writable)
Fact.Description: Form 8960 Part II line 9b, "State, local, and foreign income tax (see instructions)": the part of state, local and foreign income taxes, real property taxes and personal property taxes that is ATTRIBUTABLE to net investment income. The instructions leave the split to the filer, "You can determine the portion of your state, local, and foreign income taxes ... allocable to NII using any reasonable method", and name a ratio of gross investment income to AGI only as one example among others. A reasonable method election is not a fact the graph can derive from the return, so the allocated amount is an intake. Sales taxes are never included, and no foreign income tax is included for a year in which a credit was taken for any part of it (section 275(a)(4)).

Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 9c, miscellaneous investment expenses (writable)
Fact.Description: Form 8960 Part II line 9c, "Miscellaneous investment expenses (see instructions)". The 2025 instructions state that miscellaneous itemized deductions remain disallowed under section 67(g), made permanent by P.L. 119-21 section 70110, so on most returns this line is $0; the line is still printed and still accepts the expenses that survive as allowed. Nothing in the graph records them, so it is an intake.

Fact.Name: Form 8960 Part I header, the section 6013(g) election box
Fact.Description: Form 8960 Part I prints three election boxes above line 1, and this is the first: "Section 6013(g) election (see instructions)", the election by a US citizen or resident and a nonresident alien spouse to be treated as residents for the whole year. It is not derivable from any fact the graph holds, so it is an intake. Checking this box is a SEPARATE election from the one that sets the return's own MFJ filing status (form1040:/writableForm1040NonresidentAlienSpouseElection) — it is the instructions' "elect to apply the joint return election for NIIT purposes," and /niitThreshold reads /niitAppliesSection6013ElectionForNiitPurposes (true when this box or the section 6013(h) box is checked) to decide whether an NRA-spouse-elected MFJ filer keeps the $250,000 MFJ threshold or falls back to the $125,000 MFS threshold. Bool, unanswered on the ordinary return.

Fact.Name: Form 8960 Part I header, the section 6013(h) election box
Fact.Description: Form 8960 Part I header box two, "Section 6013(h) election (see instructions)": the election by a dual status individual and their spouse, where one is a US citizen or resident at year end, to be treated as residents for the whole year. Intake for the same reason as the section 6013(g) box above. This box and the section 6013(g) box are the two ways to make /niitAppliesSection6013ElectionForNiitPurposes true, which /niitThreshold reads on the same terms described on that box's Description.

Fact.Name: Form 8960 is required for this return
Fact.Description:
THE RENDER GATE for Form 8960, taken verbatim from the printed rule: "Attach Form 8960 to your return if your modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) is greater than the applicable threshold amount" (Instructions for Form 8960, Who Must File). So: /niitMagi strictly greater than /niitThreshold — the same two quantities Part III lines 13 and 14 print, and whose difference line 15 already computes as /niitLine15MagiOverTheThreshold.
THE TEST IS ON MAGI ALONE, NOT ON THE TAX. A return over the threshold whose net investment income is zero owes no NIIT (line 16 takes the smaller of line 12 and line 15) and still attaches the form; gating on /netInvestmentIncomeTax greater than $0 would drop exactly those returns, which is the failure the printed sentence is written to prevent. The gate is deliberately over-inclusive in the direction the instructions state.
NOT COMPLETE-SAFE, deliberately: /niitMagi is Incomplete on a return whose MAGI inputs are unanswered, and this gate inherits that Incomplete rather than answering "no form" for a return nobody has measured yet.

Fact.Name: NIIT net operating loss carryforward components
Fact.Description: One item per distinct originating-taxpayer/loss-year NOL component used on this 2025 regular return. Enter a component once, never once per asset. Supply the historical regular and investment-only Form 172 calculations; this collection computes the section 1411 fraction and its application, not the historical section 172 worksheets. Empty/unopened means no separately itemized NIIT NOL; manual line-7 residual must exclude these amounts. No new carryback, loss-year recomputation, acquisition-of-loss or marital-status allocation is inferred.

Fact.Name: NOL loss year
Fact.Description: Calendar loss year beginning after 2012 and before 2025. Earlier losses can reduce regular income but cannot generate a section 1411 NOL deduction. An entered record requires an explicit amount, including zero where applicable.

Fact.Name: Regular NOL originally determined
Fact.Description: Original positive section 172 loss for this taxpayer and loss year, before any use; not the remaining carryforward. An entered record requires an explicit amount, including zero where applicable.

Fact.Name: Investment-only hypothetical NOL
Fact.Description: Nonnegative historical Form 172 NOL recomputed using only NII income and properly allocable deductions, excluding any section 1411 NOL deduction. It is not the current Form 8960 line-12 loss. An entered record requires an explicit amount, including zero where applicable.

Fact.Name: Regular NOL previously absorbed
Fact.Description: Regular section 172 NOL from this component already absorbed in all prior carryback/carryforward years. Exclude any waived or legally unavailable carryback; include actual lawful prior absorption. An entered record requires an explicit amount, including zero where applicable.

Fact.Name: Regular NOL absorbed on this 2025 return
Fact.Description: The portion of the regular section 172 deduction actually used from this component in 2025 after applicable section 172 limits and ordering. Not a fresh NIIT election and not the unused carryforward. An entered record requires an explicit amount, including zero where applicable.

Fact.Name: NIIT loss component input consistency
Fact.Description: All five inputs must be answered; original regular loss is positive; loss year is 2013-2024; amounts are nonnegative; previous plus current use cannot exceed the original loss. Invalid or absent inputs do not produce a dollar deduction.

Fact.Name: Section 1411 NOL for the originating loss year
Fact.Description: Lesser of the original regular NOL and the hypothetical investment-only NOL. The original fraction is fixed for this loss component; do not recompute it from the remaining carryforward.

Fact.Name: Remaining regular NOL after 2025 absorption
Fact.Description: Original regular NOL less prior absorption and current lawful use, never a silently floored overdrawn amount. Export for a future-year carryforward record; this does not choose section 172 ordering.

Fact.Name: Applicable section 1411 NOL deduction for 2025
Fact.Description: Current regular NOL use multiplied by the ORIGINAL section 1411 NOL divided by the ORIGINAL regular NOL. Both fraction terms are scaled by 100 before Dollar multiplication/division so cent-sized source amounts do not round a percentage prematurely. Final result is a native cent amount; Form 8960 line 8 rounds the combined result by the existing rule.

Fact.Name: Regular NOL use represented in NIIT records
Fact.Description: Sum of current regular NOL absorption entered in the NIIT loss-component collection, or zero when the collection is not opened. Used only to reconcile to the ACTUAL regular-return deduction, not to calculate that deduction.

Fact.Name: Sum of applicable section 1411 NOL deductions
Fact.Description: Sum of validated loss-component deductions. An incomplete component propagates; the line-7 wrapper handles the unopened collection.

Fact.Name: Form 8960 line 7, applicable NOL deduction
Fact.Description: Negative sum of each itemized applicable section 1411 NOL deduction. Represented regular use cannot exceed the signed Schedule 1 line-8a deduction already computed by income. The total can be less, for example when a pre-2013 NOL is also used. Incomplete/overdrawn selected records stay Incomplete. A joint regular return with separate NIIT under a nonresident-spouse election is not allocated here and stays Incomplete; no records leave the old route unchanged.

Fact.Name: CFC and QEF annual NIIT reconciliations
Fact.Description: One record per distinct issuer/owner holding, directly held as a portfolio investment. This route replaces the two legacy elected/no-election CFC/QEF line-6 amount boxes, not the section 1291 or 1296 legs or unrelated residual adjustments. Include all annual CFC/QEF inclusions and distributions being reconciled by this route. The calculation uses regular-return inclusions already reported, not a second source of regular income.

Fact.Name: Section 1.1411-10(g) election applies to this holding
Fact.Description: Whether a valid section 1.1411-10(g) election is in effect for this specific holding in 2025. False is not inferred from a blank. Mixed elected and unelected issuers are permitted. Making the statutory election and attaching the required statement are separate filing obligations.

Fact.Name: Annual portfolio reconciliation and source records confirmed
Fact.Description: True only after confirming the amounts are already in the regular return as described, previously taxed distributions are excluded from chapter 1 and characterized under section 959(d)/1293(c), and the prior-NIIT portion is documented (including any qualifying predecessor history). This bounded route excludes direct/indirect stock dispositions, basis transfers, interest-expense adjustments, section 1411 business holdings and special pre-2014 transition cases. Amounts entered elsewhere on NIIT and manual residuals must not overlap this reconciliation. False/blank leaves calculations Incomplete; use separately supported calculations for excluded populations.

Fact.Name: Section 951(a) and 951A inclusions in regular AGI
Fact.Description: Actual combined inclusions from this holding included in this return AGI; exclude QEF earnings entered separately. An opened record requires an explicit nonnegative amount, including zero.

Fact.Name: Section 1293(a)(1)(A) QEF ordinary earnings in AGI
Fact.Description: Actual QEF ordinary earnings included in AGI, after any applicable regular-return adjustments, not an invented Form 8621 amount. An opened record requires an explicit nonnegative amount, including zero.

Fact.Name: Section 1293(a)(1)(B) QEF net capital gain in AGI
Fact.Description: Current QEF long-term capital inclusion carried by the regular return. Do not enter stock-sale gains on this annual-only route. An opened record requires an explicit nonnegative amount, including zero.

Fact.Name: Chapter-1-excluded previously taxed distributions
Fact.Description: Current distribution treated under section 959(d) or 1293(c), excluded from regular AGI, before subtracting the documented portion already included in NIIT in a prior period. An opened record requires an explicit nonnegative amount, including zero.

Fact.Name: Distribution attributable to earnings already included in NIIT
Fact.Description: Portion of the current previously taxed distribution whose underlying earnings were already included in NII under the applicable rules. Document the history; do not assume zero from a missing record. Prior inclusion in NII is the test, not whether the taxpayer actually paid NIIT on those earnings; a prior below-threshold return can still have included the earnings in NII. An opened record requires an explicit nonnegative amount, including zero.

Fact.Name: Current ordinary inclusions already in Form 8960 lines 1-5
Fact.Description: Part of the section 951/951A and QEF ordinary inclusions above already reflected in NII before line 6. Same dollars only; other dividends and current distributions do not belong here. An opened record requires an explicit nonnegative amount, including zero.

Fact.Name: QEF current capital inclusion represented in line 5a
Fact.Description: The portion of the QEF capital inclusion already accounted for by Form 8960 line 5a. This is a component before netting with unrelated capital losses, not capped by the net line-5a total. An opened record requires an explicit nonnegative amount, including zero.

Fact.Name: Taxable-for-NIIT distribution already included before line 6
Fact.Description: Part of the current previously taxed distribution that remains taxable for NIIT after prior-NIIT history and is already represented elsewhere in NII. It cannot exceed the taxable-for-NIIT distribution. Do not subtract a prior-period NIIT portion twice. An opened record requires an explicit nonnegative amount, including zero.

Fact.Name: CFC/QEF source amount consistency
Fact.Description: Checks explicit scope/election answers, complete nonnegative amounts and that each already-included or previously-taxed portion is no greater than its corresponding source amount. It cannot authenticate a supplied foreign tax history; that is the source-record obligation.

Fact.Name: Combined regular ordinary inclusions from this holding
Fact.Description: Section 951(a)/951A plus section 1293(a)(1)(A) amounts already reported on the regular return. Internal reconciliation only; never add this output to Schedule 1 or AGI again.

Fact.Name: Previously taxed distribution still taxable for NIIT
Fact.Description: Current chapter-1-excluded distribution less the documented portion whose earnings were already included in NIIT. Same amount increases NIIT MAGI; it is not new regular gross income.

Fact.Name: One for an elected holding
Fact.Description: Internal sum indicator. Missing election is caught by the item validation and is not treated as a valid no-election record.

Fact.Name: Holding contribution to Form 8960 line 6
Fact.Description: With an election, include current ordinary and QEF capital inclusions not already on the form. Without an election, remove current ordinary inclusions already in NII; QEF capital removal belongs to line 5b. In either case add only the current previously taxed distribution still taxable for NIIT and not already represented. Signed; no floor here.

Fact.Name: Unelected QEF capital exclusion on worksheet row 2(f)
Fact.Description: Negative of the unelected QEF current capital inclusion represented in line 5a, or zero for an elected holding. This same signed column-(A) contribution must enter the existing row-2(i) capital-loss-carryforward reconciliation. It is not a capital loss on a stock disposal.

Fact.Name: Holding contribution to NIIT MAGI worksheet line 3
Fact.Description: Increase AGI by chapter-1-excluded distributions included in NII. For a holding without the election also subtract current section 951/951A and BOTH ordinary and capital QEF inclusions in AGI. An elected holding retains those current inclusions in MAGI. Signed; MAGI can be below AGI. Not a computation of foreign corporate income or share-disposal basis.

Fact.Name: Unvalidated annual CFC/QEF line-6 sum
Fact.Description: Internal sum used to check completeness before selecting the detailed route. Public line-6 output additionally enforces no legacy overlap, election disclosure and return scope.

Fact.Name: Unvalidated annual CFC/QEF MAGI sum
Fact.Description: Internal sum used to check completeness before selecting the detailed route; not the filed MAGI adjustment.

Fact.Name: Selected CFC/QEF reconciliation is complete and nonoverlapping
Fact.Description: Each item must resolve; both legacy CFC/QEF amount boxes must be blank or zero; an elected item requires the existing Form 8960 election header flag answered true. The header alone does not elect every entity. A joint regular return with separate NIIT under a nonresident-spouse election needs per-owner MAGI allocation not provided here and is excluded. No same-collection aggregate is read by an item.

Fact.Name: Derived annual CFC/QEF line-6 adjustment
Fact.Description: Zero if the detail collection is unopened. When selected, sum the validated per-holding line6Adjustment amounts; selected invalid/missing records or a legacy amount conflict remain Incomplete, never silently fall back to manual amounts.
